newsitem.title: USA: Stepan and Reichhold to expand production.
newsitem.headline: Stepan and Reichhold to expand production.

text.p: Stepan Co, a specialty chemical manufacturer, said Monday it reached an agreement with Reichhold Co, to expand a phthalic anhydride (PA) plant at Stepan's Millsdale, Ill. facility.

Under terms of the agreement, Reichhold will provide funding for the expansion. Equipment is presently on order and the expansion is expected to be completed by the fourth quarter of 1997. This will bring the capacity of the PA plant from 180 to 240 million pounds annually.
Other terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

Phthalic anhydride is a commodity chemical used in the manufacture of plasticizers for use in many plastics such as auto upholstery, vinyl coated fabrics, toys, insulation for wire and cable, and medical products like intravenous solution tubes.
Reichhold, located in Research Triange Park, N.C., makes coating and unsaturated polyester resins.
